requests.what: Add four first-half harness reasons (exit 3, raised through the freeze-check hook of N39a-18): `freeze-home-task-unexplained` (N39a-20 step 6: the frozen rival's home-task training time on trj is above 1.2 x its published figure and no written explanation is attached; repairs: fix the installation; attach the explanation, after which the measured figure replaces the published one); `freeze-selection-not-minimum` (N39a-20 step 2: the frozen configuration is not the smallest development restricted mean time and no tie-break reason is recorded; repair: freeze the fastest candidate or record the reason); `armc-engine-differs` (N39a-21: arm C pins an engine, learner or environment revision other than arm B's for the stratum, or a second engine; repair: pin arm B's revisions); `armc-forbidden-use` (N39a-21: an arm C pack file imports or invokes a FrankenRobotics crate, binary or artifact, or names the adjudicating simulator; repair: remove it). Also widen the trigger of `freeze-rival-underbuilt` to include a `sustained` under-built objection with no recorded response (N39a-20 step 5), which its repair column already mentions.

N39a-31 now states that its parameter-set record `tenfold/<gate>/noninferiority.json` holds only option, mode and population_mode as its own, and copies margin and level from the ratified block. Please add the check that refuses a block whose `noninferiority_margin` or `level` differs from that record's, or whose named non-inferiority option differs from its `option` (test e.g. `noninferiority_record_matches_block`), so the margin has one source of authority (an option C or E that moves the margin is then an amendment of the block).

The command `frob-conformance tenfold require-owner-inputs --json` names a `frob-conformance` binary, which ADR-GAUNT-01 (BD-025) rules out; the ten-fold harness's operator binary is `frob-tenfold` (N39a-01). Please spell it `frob-tenfold require-owner-inputs --json` (a subcommand added to that binary; N39a-01 is already upstream through N39b-31). N39a-40 now depends on this bead, calls `owner_inputs::require_frozen_inputs()` before every sealing step (through a new step-precondition registry in N39a-15) and through the freeze-check hook of N39a-18, and its script runs the `frob-tenfold` form.

Same command-form issue: please spell `frob-conformance tenfold require-adjudication --gate <partial|tournament> --json` as `frob-tenfold require-adjudication --gate <partial|tournament> --json` (subcommand of N39a-01's operator binary; add dep N39a-01 if the command is defined here). N39a-40 now depends on this bead directly and calls `adjudication::require_record(gate)` as a precondition of sealing step 2 (`commit-suite`, the entry that binds the sealed families); it also lists in its gate record any sealed-pool family created before the record's date. If family creation in the sealed pool (N39a-13) must itself be refused, that needs a call from N39a-13, which neither bead currently has.

'Crate. crates/frob-conformance/ (library plus test targets; no binary, no verb)' contradicts N39a-01, which puts two operator binaries in this crate (`src/bin/frob-tenfold.rs`, `src/bin/frob-tenfold-score.rs`, beside the crate's end-to-end log tool). Suggest: 'no `frob-conformance` binary and no verb; the operator tools of the ten-fold harness (`frob-tenfold`, `frob-tenfold-score`, N39a-01) and the end-to-end log tool are the only binaries, and none runs a gate', so that N39a-01, N39a-40, N41-06 and N41-15 can be implemented as written.
